findings.current: They realized that the first giant to step forward was a middle-aged D-rank Hunter whose only real thing to boast about was twenty years of experience.
findings.defect: “The first giant” and “only real thing to boast about” are awkward literal phrasing that disrupts the otherwise natural action-comedy narration.

findings.current: Now that I had become a famous person in the modern world, there were very few people with whom I could have a completely selfless conversation like this one.

findings.rationale: The replacement naturally expresses Taekyung’s mistaken belief that neither participant wants anything from the other, preserving the dramatic irony.
findings.replacement: Now that I was famous in the modern world, there were very few people I could have a completely agenda-free conversation with.

findings.replacement: He had no hesitation about talking himself up.

findings.current: So the other side were Hunters.
findings.defect: The collective singular subject creates an awkward agreement error in US English.
findings.rationale: The replacement resolves the agreement problem without changing Taekyung’s inference.
